exposure: timing of antepartum elective caesarean delivery
cohort: Term nulliparous women with a singleton gestation undergoing antepartum elective caesarean delivery at a large obstetric centre in Shanghai, China between 2007 and 2014
finding: Neonatal outcome data suggest that delivery at 39-39 6/7 complete weeks is optimal timing in a Chinese population undergoing elective caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: In a Chinese population, elective cesarean delivery at 39-39 6/7 weeks gestation was associated with optimal neonatal outcomes compared to other gestational ages.
